title: Manufacturing — material property lookup
task: Go to https://webbook.nist.gov/chemistry/ and look up the substance ethanol by its CAS registry number, 64-17-5. Open the matching substance record and read the general information NIST lists for it. Then report exactly four values: the IUPAC name, the molecular formula, the molecular weight in g/mol, and the CAS registry number printed on the record. Also state whether that CAS registry number matches the 64-17-5 you searched for. Stop once you have reported those four values and the match verdict.
